messages:
natalie: FYI: Tomorrow 07:00 PT we flip the VendorStack marketplace tile + bundled HW image. We need a clear partner-SEV lane that covers marketplace, HW imaging, and SI integration. Keep it machine-friendly and human-clear.

raj: Good call. I recommend a single shared ops channel that all alerts post to, plus two parallel paging lanes: marketplace issues -> marketplace PD policy, hw-image failures -> infra PD policy. Then a combined warroom if cross-surface.

Hannah: Agree. Propose deterministic channel name: #vs-launch-ops.<env> (e.g. #vs-launch-ops.prod). Pin two artifacts: runbook.md and a 1-line comms template for CSMs. Also request a dedicated hw-oncall alias for quick paging.

jorge: For timeline, keep it strict: 0-8m partner/SI triage in channel -> 8-20m Redwood infra oncall -> 20-45m partner eng + SI deep-dive -> 45m+ open warroom + exec notify. Add explicit region-failover: if us-west PD saturated, route to apac-oncall with note "regional-fallthrough".

natalie: Can ops-bot scaffold the channel and create two PD policies and a bridge template automatically when we schedule the launch? would be nice.

ops-bot: action: /scaffold launch vs-launch-ops.prod --pins runbook.md,csmsnippet.md --pd-policies marketplace:PD1234,hw:PD2345 --bridge-template "vs-launch-warroom" --invite @natalie,@raj,@Hannah,@jorge

raj: Runbook should include: contact list (partner eng lead, SI lead, CSM), alert routing map, escalation timeline, warm-watch rota (2 people first 6h, check-ins every 30m), and postmortem trigger (auto-assign if Sev2+).

Hannah: I'll draft the pinned checklist. Minimal fields: incident owner, impacted surface (marketplace/hw/si), region, customer-facing? Y/N, immediate mitigation steps, rollback toggle, PD policy id, postmortem owner.

jorge: Also include a short Slack workflow snippet to capture incident metadata at first post: \n```\n/workflow vs-incident-capture -> fields [surface,region,severity,customer_impact,owner] -> post to #vs-launch-ops.prod\n```

natalie: For comms, we'll add a one-sentence blurb in the partner announcement: "Operational path: #vs-launch-ops.prod (warm-watch 48h); see pinned runbook for escalation, paging, and CSM template." Keeps partners and sales expectations aligned.

raj: One more: automatic bridge creation if combined surface alert fires (marketplace+hw) or severity >= P1. Template: \n```\n/bridge create vs-launch-warroom --title "VendorStack Launch Warroom" --ops @natalie,@raj,@Hannah,@jorge --duration 4h --auto-post-status 30m\n```

ops-bot: note: automation rule created: if alert.tags contains ["marketplace","hw"] OR alert.severity=="P1" -> create bridge vs-launch-warroom and page PD1234,PD2345

Hannah: Recommend we do a dry-run tonight to validate webhooks, PD policies, and bridge template. Also add a simple escalation matrix in the runbook so partners know who owns postmortem.

jorge: I'll take care of the dry-run and report back. Also, suggest we include a tiny rollback checklist for the HW image (steps + safe-image id) pinned for quick use.

natalie: Thanks. I'll publish the channel and drop the initial draft runbook. After dry-run, we'll finalize PD policy ids and the 48h warm-watch roster. :thumbsup:
